Summary
- What part of the codebase needs improvement and why?

Context
- Background, constraints, and prior attempts.

Proposal
- Outline the refactor or improvement and expected benefits.

Scope
- In scope:
- Out of scope:

Risks
- Potential regressions and how to mitigate.

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Clear before/after metrics or quality bar
- [ ] No behavioral changes (unless specified)
